clue.text: In the paperst there's American company for a royal lady

indicators.note: the company is placed inside the word for the newspapers, as 'In' says

parts.note: the papers collectively are the press
Inc, short for incorporated, follows the name of an American company

explanation.surface: A newspaper report says a US firm has been set up for a member of the royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: A king's daughter is a royal lady by birth.

clue.text: Make good a loss concerning a masterstroke

parts.note: re is the Latin-derived word for concerning, as in business letters
a coup is a brilliant, successful stroke

explanation.surface: A financier wins back lost money with one brilliant move.
explanation.definitionFit: To win back money that was lost is to make good the loss.

clue.text: Composition on reversible grid

indicators.note: reversible tells us the little word on is turned round to read the other way

parts.note: a net is a mesh or grid of cords

explanation.surface: A design printed on a grid that can be turned either way.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of music written for nine players is a type of composition.

clue.text: Old pattern of squares in the treasury

parts.note: ex means former or old, as in ex-wife
a chequer is a pattern of alternating coloured squares, as on a chessboard

explanation.surface: An antique checked design is kept in the treasury building.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's government finance department is called by this name, after the chequered cloth once used for counting money.

clue.text: Politician shed no tears

indicators.note: shed suggests the letters are cast off and scattered, then gathered in a new order

explanation.surface: A hard-faced politician who never cried.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a senate, such as the US upper house, is an elected politician.

clue.text: Go back, about to give up

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to cede is to give up or surrender territory

explanation.surface: An army retreats, about to surrender.
explanation.definitionFit: To recede is to withdraw or move backwards, like a tide.

clue.text: Go over again and get some more capsules

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A patient told to repeat the prescription and collect more pills.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'and get', but those are link words joining definition to wordplay; 'Go over again' alone substitutes for the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To recapitulate a point is to go over it once more, summarising.

clue.text: Mother absorbed in wicked objects in early February

indicators.note: one piece is soaked up inside the other, so it sits within it

parts.note: candles are objects with wicks, a playful reading of wicked
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A mother caught up in evil things at the start of February.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wicked' looks like 'evil' but means 'having wicks'. The Christian feast of the Purification falls on 2 February.
explanation.definitionFit: The feast day falls on the second of the month, so it is a date in early February.

clue.text: Hector worker going round the pit

indicators.note: one word goes round another, enclosing it

parts.note: a doer is one who works or acts
a mine is a pit dug for coal

explanation.surface: A bullying foreman stalks around the colliery.
explanation.definitionFit: To hector is to bully or boss people about, a verb of the same sense.

clue.text: Following a conventional type of image

explanation.surface: An adjective describing a stock portrait.
explanation.definitionFit: Iconic art follows set traditional forms; the word also means relating to an icon or picture.

clue.text: Holloway, that's not the real title!

definitions.text: Holloway, that's not the real title!

parts.words: Holloway, that's not the real title!
parts.note: Holloway is a London prison, slang 'nick', and the exclamation says this is a name other than the true one

explanation.surface: Someone protesting that a London district's name is not genuine.
explanation.walkthrough: HOLLOWAY is a women's prison in London; British slang for prison is NICK, and a title is a NAME.
explanation.definitionFit: A familiar substitute for someone's proper name is an informal title, not the real one.

clue.text: It comes with intelligence the result of a division sum

definitions.text: the result of a division sum

explanation.surface: A remark about clever people and arithmetic.
explanation.definitionFit: IQ stands for intelligence followed by this word; it also names what one number divided by another yields.

clue.text: Fence becoming ashen

explanation.surface: A garden boundary turning grey.
explanation.definitionFit: A fence of pointed stakes bears this name, and turning white-faced is going pale.

clue.text: Old-fashioned piece of music familiar to mathematicians

parts.note: square is slang for conventional or old-fashioned
a number is a song or musical item in a show

explanation.surface: A dated tune that maths people know well.
explanation.definitionFit: Values such as nine or sixteen, a figure times itself, are a familiar concept in mathematics.

clue.text: Squash me, I could become easily shocked

indicators.note: could become says the letters may turn into something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone timid saying a squash game would leave them nervous.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who is readily nauseated or upset is easily shocked.

clue.text: No French golfer perhaps-one would not expect to find him behind the wheel

definitions.text: one would not expect to find him behind the wheel

parts.note: non is French for no
a driver is a golf club, here playfully called a golfer

explanation.surface: A French golfer turning down a lift, being no motorist.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who does not drive a car would not be seen at a steering wheel.

clue.text: Leave in genuine reward

indicators.note: in means the first word goes inside the second

parts.note: real means genuine
to quit is to leave

explanation.surface: An employee resigns for a genuine bonus.
explanation.definitionFit: Requital is repayment or recompense for something done, a kind of reward.

clue.text: Ask chaps way back for things that are needed

parts.note: to require is to ask for or demand
chaps are men

indicators.note: back says the abbreviation for way is turned round

parts.note: St is the abbreviation of street, a way

explanation.surface: A request that blokes go back down the road for the necessary supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: Needs or necessities are what is required.

clue.text: Liam and I could accept item about soldiers

indicators.note: accept means the shuffled letters take in another piece
could suggests the letters of the names can be reworked
about says the short word is turned round

parts.note: it is a thing or item

explanation.surface: Two people agreeing to an item concerning soldiers.
explanation.walkthrough: LIAM and I are shuffled to MILIA, which accepts TI (the word for an item, IT, turned by 'about') to give the citizen army.
explanation.definitionFit: A body of civilian soldiers raised in an emergency.

clue.text: Which French revolutionary had a tart?

parts.note: qui is French for which or who
Che Guevara was a famous Latin American revolutionary

explanation.surface: A question about which revolutionary owned a pastry.
explanation.definitionFit: A savoury custard flan in pastry is a type of open tart.

clue.text: Feeling swell in the main?

parts.note: swell here is the motion of the waves, and the main is the open sea, so this is how one feels in a rough sea

explanation.surface: Asking whether someone feels great on the whole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swell' wants to mean 'great' and 'in the main' 'mostly'; the main is the sea and swell its rolling waves.
explanation.definitionFit: Seasickness on rolling waves makes one feel nauseous.

clue.text: Give up profit

explanation.surface: Surrender the gains.
explanation.definitionFit: To surrender is to yield, and a return on an investment is also called its yield.

clue.text: Bird to encourage the flower

parts.note: a lark is a songbird
to spur someone on is to encourage them

explanation.surface: A bird urging a flower to grow.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall garden plant with spurred blue blooms, related to delphinium.

clue.text: Resin usually hides the cavity

indicators.note: hides says the answer is concealed within the letters of the words before it

explanation.surface: Sticky tree sap usually fills a hollow.
explanation.definitionFit: A hollow in the bones of the skull, such as behind the nose, is an air cavity.

clue.text: Second weapon was grating

parts.note: a trident is a three-pronged spear

explanation.surface: A secondary weapon made a scraping sound.
explanation.definitionFit: A harsh, shrill sound is loud and grating.

clue.text: Churchman and I take this in France to the city

parts.note: Ven is short for Venerable, the title of an archdeacon
ce is French for this

explanation.surface: An archdeacon and I take this to a French city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian city of canals is a city in its own right.

clue.text: Everything was concealed in the old game

parts.note: all means everything
hid is the past tense of hide, so was concealed

explanation.surface: Everything was hidden away in an old-time pastime.
explanation.definitionFit: An old name for hide-and-seek, a children's game.

clue.text: Checked remoulded retreads

indicators.note: remoulded suggests the letters are reshaped, like a tyre being remade

explanation.surface: Inspected tyres that were remade.
explanation.definitionFit: To be checked or halted is to be stopped in progress.
